ruleset.name: loudsight-multithreading
ruleset.description:
PMD's bundled multithreading category, covering main AND test sources.
This project runs Aeron media drivers, pooled dispatcher threads and a thread monitor, and the defects already found in it (interrupt-flag poisoning, threads blocked with no progress) are exactly this category's subject matter. Test sources are included because the concurrency fixtures spawn real threads.
All five rules that currently fire are excluded below, so this category contributes zero findings today. It is still worth loading: the rules that matter most here - NonThreadSafeSingleton, DoubleCheckedLocking, UnsynchronizedStaticFormatter, AvoidThreadGroup and the rest - are already clean, so keeping the category costs nothing and guards them against regression. A category is not only valuable when it is complaining.
